Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1444
Claimant:
Cynthia Marks
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2023-11-20
Claim opened after a report that the insured's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The
claimant's attorney has notified our office that they will handle all further contact on the bodily injury portion.
2023-11-22
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is listed as a named driver and that coverage was in force at the time of
loss. No issues with the policy status were found.
2024-01-10
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the lane change
collision as descrbied by the other driver.
2024-02-05
Spoke with two independent witnesses who each saw the sideswipe occur and gave accounts consistent with the
other driver's statement.
2024-02-26
Reviewed scene photographs and the damage estimate. The damage pattern along the passenger side matches the
impact described by all parties, and no prior damage to the vehicle is on record.
2024-04-13
Claimant reported neck and upper back pain with stiffness, consistent with a whiplash-type injury for a collision of this
kind. The attorney provided the initial medical records.
2024-04-23
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of how the collision happened matched
the account given in every earlier conversation, with no changes in the sequence of events.
2024-06-04
Medical file shows the claimant was treated for complaints in the same body area within the past two years. The
attorney's office has been asked for those records to clarify how the prior condition interacts with the current
complaints.
2024-06-16
Received the prior treatment records. The earlier condition is documented, and the physician notes that it may add to
the current symptoms, so the current complaints are being evaluated with that in mind.
2024-06-19
Treatment followed a typical course of care and tapered as the claimant improved, with reduced visits and decreasing
reports of pain over the following weeks.
2024-06-23
Reviewed the full file. The reported injury is plausible for a crash of this type, the liability facts are supported by
independent sources, and the claim is proceeding to evaluation with the attorney on record.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
